Description

Take your love of indie bookstores everywhere you go!

 

Celebrate your love of indies! Hand-drawn illustrations – from iconic storefronts to charming sidewalk carts – bring each bookshop to life on a heavyweight canvas tote built to survive your most ambitious book hauls.

 

Details

  • Now you can support indie bookstores and look great doing it.

  • 13″W x 16″H with 5″ gusset

  • 10 oz colored cotton

  • 25″ spun poly handles

  • Printed in the US by Enviro-Tote, a family-owned, woman-owned, member of the Fair Labor Association.
